rationale: Shanzila is building LLM-based products at ReachLLM with a TypeScript foundation, while Anshu is creating security frameworks and tools to protect AI systems and agents from exploitation. Their work is naturally complementary: as Shanzila develops LLM applications, Anshu's expertise in AI security, agent safety, and LLM-specific vulnerabilities could directly inform product decisions and help embed security practices early in ReachLLM's architecture.
intro_message: Shanzila Ahmed, meet Anshu Gupta — he's building AI security frameworks and has deep conviction that LLMs can be weaponized to find real vulnerabilities, which could be valuable perspective as you scale LLM-based products at ReachLLM.
